title: A LO-TEK theme recipe
description: What `lotek theme` builds a theme from: a brand colour per family, and typography and shape. Everything is optional, and a family that is left out keeps LO-TEK's own hue. Written from src/tokens/theme-keys.ts by scripts/generate-theme-schema.ts. The core holds the keys, and its tests hold this file to them.

$schema.description: The address of this schema, for the editor. It says nothing about the theme.

accent.description: Links, buttons and focus indication. A hexadecimal colour, as #rgb or #rrggbb. The hue and chroma are yours, the lightness is the role's. Left out, the family keeps LO-TEK's own colour.

visited.description: Visited links. A hexadecimal colour, as #rgb or #rrggbb. The hue and chroma are yours, the lightness is the role's. Left out, the family keeps LO-TEK's own colour.

brand1.description: Surfaces, sections and categories. It means nothing in itself. A hexadecimal colour, as #rgb or #rrggbb. The hue and chroma are yours, the lightness is the role's. Left out, the family keeps LO-TEK's own colour.

brand2.description: Surfaces, sections and categories. It means nothing in itself. A hexadecimal colour, as #rgb or #rrggbb. The hue and chroma are yours, the lightness is the role's. Left out, the family keeps LO-TEK's own colour.

brand3.description: Surfaces, sections and categories. It means nothing in itself. A hexadecimal colour, as #rgb or #rrggbb. The hue and chroma are yours, the lightness is the role's. Left out, the family keeps LO-TEK's own colour.

neutral.description: The page, body text and borders. Almost without hue. A hexadecimal colour, as #rgb or #rrggbb. The hue and chroma are yours, the lightness is the role's. Left out, the family keeps LO-TEK's own colour.

danger.description: Errors, deletion and rejection. A hexadecimal colour, as #rgb or #rrggbb. The hue and chroma are yours, the lightness is the role's. Left out, the family keeps LO-TEK's own colour.

warning.description: Something that needs attention. A hexadecimal colour, as #rgb or #rrggbb. The hue and chroma are yours, the lightness is the role's. Left out, the family keeps LO-TEK's own colour.

success.description: Completed and approved. A hexadecimal colour, as #rgb or #rrggbb. The hue and chroma are yours, the lightness is the role's. Left out, the family keeps LO-TEK's own colour.

typography.description: The font, the weights and the line heights. Left out, LO-TEK's own typography stays.

fontFamily.description: The font stack the whole theme uses, written as in CSS. It is set as a token and as a rule on :root. Left out, LO-TEK has no font of its own and inherits the one of the page it is on.

weights.description: The four font weights, as numbers or keywords.

regular.description: The words that mark a field as required or optional, on a label and a fieldset. Left out, it is 400.

medium.description: Buttons and error text. Left out, it is 500.

semibold.description: Labels, titles of cards and dialogs, table headers and tabs. Left out, it is 600.

bold.description: Headings, and the asterisk that marks a required field. Left out, it is 700.

lineHeights.description: The four line heights, as numbers without a unit or as CSS values.

default.description: Controls: button, input, table. Left out, it is 1.5.

article.description: Body text and lists. Left out, it is 1.6.

compact.description: Small surfaces: help text, tooltip, card title. Left out, it is 1.4.

shape.description: Corners and borders. Left out, LO-TEK's own shape stays.

buttonRadius.description: The corners of the button, the pagination and the skip link, as a CSS length, or the number 0. Left out, it is 0.25rem.

fieldRadius.description: The corners of the input, the textarea and the select, as a CSS length, or the number 0. Left out, it is 0.25rem.

surfaceRadius.description: The corners of the card, dialog, popover, alert, accordion, error summary, file upload, session timeout, suggestion list, toast, tooltip and the panel of a term, as a CSS length, or the number 0. Left out, each surface keeps its own corner: 0.25rem, and 0.5rem on the card and the dialog.

buttonBorderWidth.description: The border width of the button, as a CSS length, or the number 0. Left out, it is 1px.

buttonFontWeight.description: The weight of the button text, as a number or a keyword. Left out, it follows weights.medium.
